toolArguments.prompt:
Use case: style-transfer. Asset: one complete wooden stool sprite for a square-grid RPG.
The supplied image is the 3D EDIT TARGET: an isolated complete stool, with a four-plank rectangular seat, four legs and low braces. Reskin it into finished hand-painted game artwork: warm medium-brown wood grain, worn but clean edges, carved small bevels, visible plank joints and understated joinery, with soft painted top-light and darker front faces. Retain the useful modeled geometry, full seat dimensions, leg supports, seat elevation and parallel straight edges. Refine surface art and small construction detail without redesigning, widening or rotating the stool.
Keep the entire 384x640 source canvas, exact subject position/size and transparent margins. Do not center or enlarge the small stool within that canvas. The underlying runtime frame is 192x320 with ground root (96,248) at double resolution. The 128px ground-cell pitch stays fixed, and the seat is 48px high, 3/8 of one cell width, already captured in its vertical placement. All four supports remain at the authored ground points.
Use the supplied fixed square-grid top-down oblique projection, front-facing three-quarter game view: broad visible seat top and front apron, screen-aligned ground, parallel edges, no diamond-grid rotation or perspective convergence.
Return only this complete isolated wooden stool with genuine transparent background, including the complete seat and all legs/braces. No person, floor, ground shadow, guides, labels, checkerboard paint or scene.
